claims.predicate: Closed source translation accounts for every statement of Admission reserve/release and initial ownership; actual capacity operator, owner mutation, count delta and lane selector generate the Lean executable.

From empty ownership, every serial lock-linearized reserve/release trace preserves active = owner cardinality, distinct owners and active <= selected lane limit; duplicate and rejected reservations do not acquire ownership.

Exact-owner release is idempotent, cannot remove another owner, and removes exactly one reservation when owned. Anonymous allocation uses a fresh owner and anonymous release uses the last anonymous owner, or no-op.

Extracted process_request reaps only dead registered threads, reserves the accepted socket before the sole handler allocator, registers before start and refuses without allocating. Failed construction or failed-before-start allocation releases once; started or ambiguously completed threads retain ownership until confirmed not alive. No live or not-yet-started registered thread loses its reservation.

The successful main startup topology has one public listener and zero or one literal-loopback control listener with equal normalized default profiles. Disabled control has zero handlers and no diagnostic availability claim. Enabled lanes have disjoint ownership, locks and credits; component bounds imply the combined cap, burst and rate sums.
Actual paired sockets demonstrate public saturation and independent enabled loopback health ingress, refusal before allocation, and release after normal and exceptional handler paths.

At the serialized listener callback cut there is at most one accepted-but-unreserved socket per listener, at most two in the enabled topology. Kernel backlogs are separate; accepted-before-reserve does not count as a handler reservation.
Every declaration and theorem in the admission Lean modules has an empty transitive axiom set, including no propext, sorryAx or Classical.choice.

Thread registry size equals retained socket reservations; pending, running and dead-unreaped threads count against capacity. Reaping only proven-dead threads preserves live threads <= registered threads <= selected lane limit. No extra reaper threads or unbounded pending queue exists.

failurePolicy: Any unsupported syntax, unmatched mutation, missing mapping, failed theorem, negative control escape or witness failure is BLOCKED.

representation.owners: List of injectively named live socket/object identities, with distinctness invariant; order is unobservable in the Python set.
representation.active: Natural number representation of Python exact integers on reachable nonnegative states; mutations are separately related to exact integer arithmetic.
representation.credits: Credit gates can nondeterministically refuse but cannot acquire or release ownership. Detailed refill and total admissions-over-time belong to TRF02.
representation.concurrency: Python lock linearizes the admitted reserve/release critical sections; no arbitrary external mutation of admission state.
representation.threads: One bounded registry entry and socket reservation per allocated request thread, held through start and complete native thread exit; a dead entry may retain capacity until reaped.
